title.narrative: Chad MSME Development and Access to Finance

description.narrative: The operation will focus on three inter-linked objectives to: (i) improve the business enabling environment through digitalization, regulatory modernization and capacity building around the government-to-business interface; (ii) strengthen entrepreneurship, technology adoption and capabilities at growth-oriented MSMEs especially within sectors and value chains; and (iii) promote financial inclusion and MSME finance.
To promote growth and access to finance for micro, small and medium enterprises.
